grammar.purpose: Link changes without claiming inevitable progress
grammar.explanation: 越练越熟 expresses increasing familiarity with more practice in the stated situation. 越听越不明白 is also possible: more listening can accompany less understanding. The construction links two changing degrees; it is not evidence of causation or a guarantee. Distinguish 越来越熟, which describes one changing state over time.

examples.py: zhè duàn wǒ yuè tīng yuè míng bái .
examples.en: I understand this section more as I listen.

examples.py: shuō dé yuè jí , yuè róng yì lòu zì .
examples.en: The more hastily one speaks, the easier it is to omit words.

examples.zh: 没休息的时候，我越练越累。
examples.py: méi xiū xī de shí hou , wǒ yuè liàn yuè lèi .
examples.en: When I have not rested, the more I practise the more tired I get.

commonMistakes.wrong: 越练越熟，所以任何练习都一定有效。
commonMistakes.right: 这次越练越熟，其他练习还要看实际效果。
commonMistakes.why: The grammatical link does not prove a universal learning effect.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + V + 宾语 + V + 补语
grammar.purpose: Keep the object and the performance description
grammar.explanation: 我读这段话读得很慢 repeats 读: the first occurrence carries the object; the second carries the complement. 我学汉语学了两年 gives a duration; 他跑步跑得很快 gives manner. Avoid attaching a long object and a 得 complement to an unrepeated verb as in 我读这段话得很慢. A topic-first alternative exists, but practise the stated repeated-verb pattern here.

examples.py: wǒ dú zhè duàn huà dú dé hěn màn .
examples.en: I read this section very slowly.

examples.py: tā xué hàn yǔ xué le liǎng nián .
examples.en: She has studied Chinese for two years.

examples.py: tā xiě zhè gè zì xiě le sān biàn .
examples.en: He wrote this character three times.

commonMistakes.why: Repeat the verb before the complement in this construction.

lines.zh: 这段越听越累，听力练习是不是没用？
lines.py: zhè duàn yuè tīng yuè lèi , tīng lì liàn xí shì bú shì méi yòng ?
lines.en: This section makes me more tired as I listen; is listening practice useless?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先看情况。你功课做了多久？基础哪部分不稳？
lines.py: xiān kàn qíng kuàng . nǐ gōng kè zuò le duō jiǔ ? jī chǔ nǎ bù fèn bù wěn ?
lines.en: Check the situation first; how long have you worked, and which foundations are weak?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我读这段话读得太快，基本上懂了，但题目细节漏了。
lines.py: wǒ dú zhè duàn huà dú dé tài kuài , jī běn shàng dǒng le , dàn tí mù xì jié lòu le .
lines.en: I read this section too fast; I mostly understood, but missed question details.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那先慢一点。教练说过，用力不等于实力。
lines.py: nà xiān màn yī diǎn . jiào liàn shuō guò , yòng lì bù děng yú shí lì .
lines.en: Then slow down; the coach said force is not the same as actual ability.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 教材换了一本，课程还没完整做完。
lines.py: jiào cái huàn le yī běn , kè chéng hái méi wán zhěng zuò wán .
lines.en: The materials changed, and the course has not been completed.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 头两次先熟悉内容，花工夫把两句连起来。
lines.py: tóu liǎng cì xiān shú xī nèi róng , huā gōng fu bǎ liǎng jù lián qǐ lái .
lines.en: Use the first two attempts to become familiar; spend time connecting the two sentences.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 得分只计算实际答案，输入错了就承认。
lines.py: dé fēn zhǐ jì suàn shí jì dá àn , shū rù cuò le jiù chéng rèn .
lines.en: Calculate scores only from actual answers and acknowledge input mistakes.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，理论和练习结合，别没完没了地赶速度。
lines.py: hǎo , lǐ lùn hé liàn xí jié hé , bié méi wán méi liǎo de gǎn sù dù .
lines.en: Okay; connect theory and practice rather than endlessly rush speed.
lines.speaker: b

reading.purpose: Read how the practice evidence is bounded.

lines.zh: 课程的基本要求写在教材里，先看题目，再看试题问什么。
lines.py: kè chéng de jī běn yāo qiú xiě zài jiào cái lǐ , xiān kàn tí mù , zài kàn shì tí wèn shén me .
lines.en: The course’s basic requirements are in the materials; read what the question actually asks.

lines.zh: 基础要具体练，听力关掉文字再试，有提示的答案不算独立完成。
lines.py: jī chǔ yào jù tǐ liàn , tīng lì guān diào wén zì zài shì , yǒu tí shì de dá àn bù suàn dú lì wán chéng .
lines.en: Practise specific foundations; hide text for listening, and do not count hinted answers as independent.

lines.zh: 初来这里时，她先找教练，调整技术：用力不是清楚，连线中的声音也可能受设备影响。
lines.py: chū lái zhè lǐ shí , tā xiān zhǎo jiào liàn , tiáo zhěng jì shù : yòng lì bù shì qīng chǔ , lián xiàn zhōng de shēng yīn yě kě néng shòu shè bèi yǐng xiǎng .
lines.en: When first coming here, she finds the coach to adjust her technique: force is not clarity, and sound during a connection may depend on equipment.

lines.zh: 我读这段话读得很慢，是重复动词带补语；越练越熟描述这次变化，不作保证。
lines.py: wǒ dú zhè duàn huà dú dé hěn màn , shì chóng fù dòng cí dài bǔ yǔ ; yuè liàn yuè shú miáo shù zhè cì biàn huà , bù zuò bǎo zhèng .
lines.en: “I read this section slowly” repeats the verb before its complement; increasing familiarity describes this change without a guarantee.

lines.zh: 工夫是投入的时间，功夫可以说技能；功课只计算真正完成的部分。
lines.py: gōng fu shì tóu rù de shí jiān , gōng fu kě yǐ shuō jì néng ; gōng kè zhǐ jì suàn zhēn zhèng wán chéng de bù fèn .
lines.en: 工夫 can refer to invested time and 功夫 to skill; count only completed schoolwork.

lines.zh: 实力和动力不同，有动力还需要核对；理论和实践要结合。
lines.py: shí lì hé dòng lì bù tóng , yǒu dòng lì hái xū yào hé duì ; lǐ lùn hé shí jiàn yào jié hé .
lines.en: Ability differs from motivation; motivation still needs checking, and theory connects with practice.

lines.zh: 输入答案以后核对得分，指出错在时间还是地点，争取下一次少漏信息。
lines.py: shū rù dá àn yǐ hòu hé duì dé fēn , zhǐ chū cuò zài shí jiān hái shi dì diǎn , zhēng qǔ xià yī cì shǎo lòu xìn xī .
lines.en: After entering an answer, check the score and identify time-versus-place errors, aiming to omit less next time.

lines.zh: 头三天先熟悉内容，讨论没完没了时也要允许休息。
lines.py: tóu sān tiān xiān shú xī nèi róng , tǎo lùn méi wán méi liǎo shí yě yào yǔn xǔ xiū xī .
lines.en: Use the first three days to familiarize yourself, and allow rest during endless discussion.
